set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1a Steps 3-4.

Language models run locally first (P2): no recall text leaves the machine. Sherlock's 'Scene Details - A Level' column is 18,203 words (~24k tokens); L1 needs roughly 26-33k tokens plus up to 351 labels. This machine is an M3 Max with 36 GB under the default GPU memory cap; a ~14B model with native context >= 64k fits, a 32B one does not without raising the cap. This ticket owns the gold-free pilot of both model and prompts, so the prompt hash exists before the pre-registration.

Scope:
Install and pin a runtime and model; pilot model and prompts without gold; build the receipt and the guards.

Acceptance criteria:
1. An OpenAI-compatible local runtime is installed and bound to localhost; any system-setting change (e.g. the GPU memory cap) is made only with the owner's OK recorded here.
2. Model and prompts (for L0-L3) are chosen by a gold-free pilot on NN01 and NN05 only, judged on parse validity, coverage, context fit and rerun agreement; criteria and results are committed; no gold file is opened (the pilot script does not take a gold path).
3. The frozen prompt hashes and the tuning budget are recorded in a committed file for the pre-registration to cite.
4. The receipt pins weights SHA-256, runtime version, quantization, KV-cache type, context size, batch and ubatch sizes, flash-attention, rope scaling, chat-template hash, temperature 0 and seed.
5. A guard asserts that the evaluated prompt token count equals the tokens sent (silent truncation refused), with a test.
6. Rerun agreement for every prompt-cached configuration is written to a committed receipts file (rates and hashes only).
7. Arm outputs and prompt logs live under data/study (ignored).

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: Phase 1a: local pinned LLM runtime, gold-free model and prompt pilot, provenance receipt
